slides.title:
What makes a good
page title
items: Don't leave any page without a title.
It says what the page is
Descriptive and short. Skip vague ones like Home.
Not the same title repeated across the site.
Site name at the start or end
Usually your business name. Use a hyphen, colon or pipe.
slides.source: Google Search Central guidance on title links, updated December 2025

steps: Read the title of your result. That's the line people click.
